name: Shirai Eri
source:
A woman who lives next door to the protagonist.
Apparently, she spends her time streaming as a "VTuber"...?

She's cheerful when she's had a drink,
but when sober, she acts suspiciously and struggles significantly with social interaction.

[Translated from [url=https://shiratamaco.com/kazeshiro/]official website[/url]]
